items.name: graph-comark
items.title: Comark
items.description: Maps Comark ::graph-* blocks to mdxcn graph components. Install the graphs first.
items.docs: Pass graphComponents to Comark. Scalars from Markdown arrive as strings; coerceProps fixes that. graph-comark.tsx is the tag map after a full install.

items.name: graph-knap
items.title: Knap
items.description: Knap filters that emit fenced ASCII graphs (or ::graph-* blocks). Install knap separately.
items.docs: Spread graphFilters into createEngine with standardFilters. Piped value is the React props object. A string param is the title. Pass comark for a ::graph-* block.
